title: Local-client time providers can falsely claim GNSS/gpsd stratum
description: Post-fix correctness review: Source mapping permits Local-client at strata1 and4, but TimeProvider.sample has no gpsd/source-subtype evidence and accepts any bound local-client provider claiming GNSS_GPSD. Require immutable local-client subtype/quality evidence; only verified gpsd may issue stratum4 and non-gpsd clients must use stratum1. Add positive/negative tests and vectors.
